chunks: From him, from the two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), in [the matter of]
A man divorces his wife with two divorces, then he divorces her a third time while he is ill, then she inherits him.
ai.seo_question: Does a third divorce during illness prevent the wife from inheriting?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies that a triple divorce (talaq al-thalath) pronounced during illness does not prevent the wife from inheriting, distinguishing it from the general rule where a final divorce during illness might bar inheritance. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it emphasizes that the specific condition of 'illness' (marad) triggers inheritance rights regardless of the number of divorces, provided the marriage contract was not fully dissolved prior to the illness. It highlights the nuanced interaction between marital status and inheritance laws in the context of terminal illness.
